fee_notes: Standard fee is $35,500 for Traditional/Non-Traditional Store, $71,000 for Co-Branded Store. Veterans qualify for $20,000 reduced fee. During 2025 calendar year, franchisees paid $0 to $17,750 (reflecting discounts/incentives). Fee is non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: During the 2025 calendar year, franchisees paid Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $0 to $17,750.
